datasets.name: ODSPolicy
datasets.sql:
select imp.rowid, imp.* from ins_mk_policy imp
where 
imp.CID = :CID

datasets.name: ODSReport
datasets.sql:
SELECT ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME,
       ic.surname || ' ' || ic.NAME || ' ' || ic.fathername AS NAME2,
       ic.address insuredaddress,ic.mobilephone,ic.homephone,insuredtype, insuredcolor as inscolor,lower(insuredcolor)||' ,'||lower(insuredtype)||', '||insuredoutputyear as insuredcolor, insuredoutputyear,
       insuredmark||'  '||  insuredmodel as insuredmodel, insuredstatenum, underframenum, insuredbannum,
       insuredenginenum,driveintended,numseats,extrafranshiz,im.franshiz,
       ins_pkg_motorkasco.getdraccesspeople(im.id) AS driveaccesspiople,
       ins_pkg_motorkasco.getAccessoriesName(ict.id) AS accessoriesname,
       im.drivecost as avtocost, im.inssumm,  
       to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate, 
	to_char(ict.begin_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') begindate2, 
       to_char(ict.ins_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') insdate,
       to_char(ict.end_date, 'dd/mm/yyyy') enddate, 
       ict.policy_num policynum,ict.beneficiary,ict.conditions,
       theft,fire, explosion,trafficaccident, impactanyobject,
       im.ammount,ic.sex,
       val.valu_name valute,val.val_name , 
       ia.surname||' '||ia.name||' '||ia.fathername as agent, 
       ict.loanacc_id, ict.curracc_id
  FROM ins_contracts ict,
       ins_motorkasco im,      
       ins_mk_policy imp,
       ins_customers ic,
       avalute val,
       ins_agents ia
 WHERE 
ic.ID = ict.kli_id 
and ict.id = im.cid
and ict.id = imp.cid  
and ict.valute_id = val.valute(+)
and ict.agent_id = ia.id(+)
and ict.id = :CID

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.id =:CID
and type_id = 1

datasets.name: ODSTemplates
datasets.sql: select ibt.rowid, ibt.* from INS_BLOB_TEMPLATES ibt

datasets.name: ODSCustomers
datasets.sql: select rowid,id,sex,insured_typeid,name||' '||surname||' '||fathername as name from ins_customers where id=:kli_id

datasets.name: ODSMotorkasko
datasets.sql:
select mk.rowid, mk.* from ins_motorkasco mk 
where cid=:cid

datasets.name: ODSAvalute
datasets.sql:
select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute
order by valute

datasets.name: ODSOperkurs
datasets.sql:
select ic.valute_id,av.valute,av.val_name,ok.ostat from avalute av,operkurs partition(today) ok,ins_contracts ic where ic.valute_id=av.valute
 and ok.val_kod=av.valute
